procedure_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# judge-58.sh -- S58 final-judge aggregation, souji-shokunin round 2.
# Judges the wave's candidate implementations (tools/souji-verify.sh plus
# tools/souji-verify.impl-*.sh) after the candidate set has been quiet for
# QUIESCE seconds, runs an identical read-only battery per candidate, and
# writes tests/results/final-58.json. All scratch under $WORK (mktemp -d).
# Exit 0 always: the verdict lives in the artifact.
set -euo pipefail

REPO=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin
ROOT=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin
OUT="$REPO/tests/results/final-58.json"
WORK="${JUDGE_WORK:?JUDGE_WORK must be set}"
WAIT_S="${JUDGE_WAIT_S:-1500}"
QUIESCE="${JUDGE_QUIESCE:-120}"
MAX_RUNTIME="${JUDGE_MAX_RUNTIME:-2400}"
CAND_BUDGET="${JUDGE_CAND_BUDGET:-900}"
KOTODAMA="$ROOT/kotodama-shokunin"
DATE="$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z)"
START_TS=$(date +%s)

export SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$ROOT"
mkdir -p "$WORK/c" "$WORK/bin" "$WORK/log" "$WORK/out"

# ---- git shim: logs every invocation; blocks forbidden porcelain verbs on
# ---- targets outside /tmp (a correct tool never triggers the block).
cat > "$WORK/bin/git" <<'SHIM'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
LOG="${JUDGE_GIT_LOG:?}"
REAL_GIT=/usr/bin/git
args=("$@")
verb=""; target="$PWD"; i=0
while [ $i -lt ${#args[@]} ]; do
  a="${args[$i]}"
  case "$a" in
    -C) i=$((i+1)); target="${args[$i]:-}";;
    -c) i=$((i+1));;
    --git-dir=*) target="${a#*=}";;
    --work-tree=*) target="${a#*=}";;
    --*) ;;
    *) verb="$a"; break;;
  esac
  i=$((i+1))
done
case "$verb" in
  fetch|push|commit|branch|checkout|reset|rebase)
    case "$target" in
      /tmp|/tmp/*) printf 'ALLOW-TMP %s target=%s cwd=%s\n' "$verb" "$target" "$PWD" >> "$LOG" ;;
      *) printf 'VIOLATION %s target=%s cwd=%s\n' "$verb" "$target" "$PWD" >> "$LOG"
         echo "judge58-shim: blocked forbidden git $verb on $target" >&2; exit 128;;
    esac ;;
esac
printf 'CALL %s cwd=%s\n' "${args[*]}" "$PWD" >> "$LOG"
exec "$REAL_GIT" "$@"
SHIM
chmod +x "$WORK/bin/git"
export PATH="$WORK/bin:$PATH"

# ---- helpers ----
snap_git() { # snap_git <repo> <outdir> <tag>
  local repo="$1" d="$2" tag="$3"
  /usr/bin/git --no-optional-locks -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD > "$d/snap.$tag.head" 2>/dev/null || echo none > "$d/snap.$tag.head"
  /usr/bin/git --no-optional-locks -C "$repo" for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' > "$d/snap.$tag.refs" 2>/dev/null || echo none > "$d/snap.$tag.refs"
  /usr/bin/git --no-optional-locks -C "$repo" status --porcelain=v1 > "$d/snap.$tag.status" 2>/dev/null || echo none > "$d/snap.$tag.status"
}
set_sig() { # signature of the candidate set (name|size|mtime per line)
  local f
  for f in "$REPO"/tools/souji-verify.sh "$REPO"/tools/souji-verify.impl-*.sh; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    printf '%s|%s|%s\n' "$(basename "$f")" "$(stat -c %s "$f")" "$(stat -c %Y "$f")"
  done | sort
}

# ---- phase 1: wait for a non-empty, quiet candidate set ----
waited=0; prev=""; stable=0
while :; do
  cur="$(set_sig)"
  if [ -n "$cur" ] && [ "$cur" = "$prev" ]; then stable=$((stable+5)); else stable=0; fi
  prev="$cur"
  if [ -n "$cur" ] && [ "$stable" -ge "$QUIESCE" ]; then break; fi
  [ "$waited" -ge "$WAIT_S" ] && break
  sleep 5; waited=$((waited+5))
done
mapfile -t CANDIDATES < <(
  if [ -e "$REPO/tools/souji-verify.sh" ]; then printf 'souji-verify.sh\n'; fi
  set_sig | cut -d'|' -f1 | grep -v '^souji-verify\.sh$' | while read -r n; do
    printf '%s %s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$n" | sed -n 's/.*impl-\([0-9]*\)\.sh/\1/p')" "$n"
  done | sort -n -k1,1 | cut -d' ' -f2
)
printf 'waited_s=%s quiesce_s=%s candidates=%s\n' "$waited" "$QUIESCE" "${#CANDIDATES[@]}" > "$WORK/discovery.txt"
{
  printf '%s\n' "waited=$waited" "stable_for=$stable" "quiesce=$QUIESCE"
  printf '%s\n' "$prev" | sed 's/^/sig=/'
} >> "$WORK/discovery.txt"

# global live snapshots (souji repo: critical; kotodama: informational)
snap_git "$REPO" "$WORK" repo_global_before
snap_git "$KOTODAMA" "$WORK" kotodama_global_before

# deterministic pushed-target pick (first existing path from fleet commit b2f2efa)
pushed_rel=""
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  if [ -e "$ROOT/$f" ]; then pushed_rel="$f"; break; fi
done < <(/usr/bin/git -C "$ROOT" show --name-only --format='' b2f2efa 2>/dev/null || true)

# ---- phase 2: judge each candidate with an identical battery ----
for name in "${CANDIDATES[@]}"; do
  file="$REPO/tools/$name"
  base="$WORK/c/$name"
  mkdir -p "$base/out" "$base/refuse"
  if [ $(( $(date +%s) - START_TS )) -gt "$MAX_RUNTIME" ]; then
    printf 'name=%s\nskipped=global-runtime-guard\nsha=%s\nsize=%s\nmode=%s\n' "$name" \
      "$(sha256sum "$file" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)" "$(stat -c %s "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" "$(stat -c %a "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo -)" > "$base/state"
    continue
  fi
  export JUDGE_GIT_LOG="$base/git.log"; : > "$JUDGE_GIT_LOG"
  sha_before="$(sha256sum "$file" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  t0=$(date +%s)
  elapsed() { echo $(( $(date +%s) - t0 )); }
  skipped=0

  run() { # run <suffix> <timeout> <args...>
    local suffix="$1" timeout_s="$2"; shift 2
    local rc=0
    ( cd "$base/out" && timeout "$timeout_s" bash "$file" "$@" ) > "$base/out/$suffix.out" 2> "$base/out/$suffix.err" || rc=$?
    printf '%s' "$rc" > "$base/out/$suffix.rc"
  }

  snap_git "$REPO" "$base" repo_before
  snap_git "$KOTODAMA" "$base" kotodama_before

  syntax_rc=1
  if bash -n "$file" 2> "$base/out/syntax.err"; then syntax_rc=0; fi
  printf '%s' "$syntax_rc" > "$base/out/syntax.rc"

  selftest_rc1=na; selftest_rc2=na
  run selftest1 240 --selftest; selftest_rc1="$(cat "$base/out/selftest1.rc")"
  run selftest2 240 --selftest; selftest_rc2="$(cat "$base/out/selftest2.rc")"
  run usaged 30 --definitely-not-a-flag; usage_rc="$(cat "$base/out/usaged.rc")"
  run noargs 30; noargs_rc="$(cat "$base/out/noargs.rc")"

  printf 'placeholder\n' > "$base/refuse/leak.env"
  run sec 60 "$base/refuse/leak.env"; sec_rc="$(cat "$base/out/sec.rc")"

  kot_root_rc=na; kot_scratch_rc=na; pushed_rc=na
  if [ "$(elapsed)" -le "$CAND_BUDGET" ]; then
    run kot_root 240 "$KOTODAMA"; kot_root_rc="$(cat "$base/out/kot_root.rc")"
  else skipped=2; fi
  if [ "$(elapsed)" -le "$CAND_BUDGET" ]; then
    run kot_scratch 480 "$KOTODAMA/.scratch"; kot_scratch_rc="$(cat "$base/out/kot_scratch.rc")"
  else skipped=3; fi
  if [ -n "$pushed_rel" ] && [ "$(elapsed)" -le "$CAND_BUDGET" ]; then
    run pushed 240 "$ROOT/$pushed_rel"; pushed_rc="$(cat "$base/out/pushed.rc")"
  elif [ -z "$pushed_rel" ]; then pushed_rc="skip"; fi

  fmt_ok=0
  if [ -s "$base/out/kot_root.out" ]; then
    fmt_ok=1
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      [ -n "$line" ] || continue
      nf=$(printf '%s' "$line" | awk -F'\t' '{print NF}')
      f1=$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -f1)
      f3=$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -f3)
      if [ "$nf" -lt 5 ] || [ "$f1" != VERDICT ] || ! printf '%s' "$f3" | grep -qE '^(SAFE|NOT-SAFE)'; then
        fmt_ok=0; break
      fi
    done < "$base/out/kot_root.out"
  fi

  static_matches=-1
  if [ -f "$file" ]; then
    sed 's/#.*$//' "$file" | grep -nE '\bgit[[:space:]]+(-C[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+)?(fetch|push|commit|branch|checkout|reset|rebase)\b' > "$base/out/static.matches" 2>/dev/null || true
    static_matches=$(wc -l < "$base/out/static.matches")
  fi

  snap_git "$REPO" "$base" repo_after
  snap_git "$KOTODAMA" "$base" kotodama_after
  refs_unchanged=0
  [ "$(cat "$base/snap.repo_before.head")" = "$(cat "$base/snap.repo_after.head")" ] && cmp -s "$base/snap.repo_before.refs" "$base/snap.repo_after.refs" && refs_unchanged=1
  viol=$(grep -c '^VIOLATION' "$JUDGE_GIT_LOG" 2>/dev/null || true); viol=${viol:-0}
  calls=$(grep -c '^CALL' "$JUDGE_GIT_LOG" 2>/dev/null || true); calls=${calls:-0}
  allows=$(grep -c '^ALLOW-TMP' "$JUDGE_GIT_LOG" 2>/dev/null || true); allows=${allows:-0}
  cp "$JUDGE_GIT_LOG" "$base/out/git.log"

  sha="$(sha256sum "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  size="$(stat -c %s "$file")"
  mode="$(stat -c %a "$file")"
  changed=0; [ "$sha" = "$sha_before" ] || changed=1
  fixtures=""; [ -s "$base/out/selftest1.out" ] && fixtures="$(grep -oE '\bF([1-9]|10)\b' "$base/out/selftest1.out" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ' || true)"

  {
    printf 'name=%s\n' "$name"
    printf 'sha=%s\n' "$sha"
    printf 'sha_before=%s\n' "${sha_before:-na}"
    printf 'changed_during_battery=%s\n' "$changed"
    printf 'size=%s\n' "$size"
    printf 'mode=%s\n' "$mode"
    printf 'syntax_rc=%s\n' "$syntax_rc"
    printf 'selftest_rc1=%s\n' "$selftest_rc1"
    printf 'selftest_rc2=%s\n' "$selftest_rc2"
    printf 'usage_rc=%s\n' "$usage_rc"
    printf 'noargs_rc=%s\n' "$noargs_rc"
    printf 'sec_rc=%s\n' "$sec_rc"
    printf 'kot_root_rc=%s\n' "$kot_root_rc"
    printf 'kot_scratch_rc=%s\n' "$kot_scratch_rc"
    printf 'pushed_rc=%s\n' "$pushed_rc"
    printf 'fmt_ok=%s\n' "$fmt_ok"
    printf 'static_matches=%s\n' "$static_matches"
    printf 'refs_unchanged=%s\n' "$refs_unchanged"
    printf 'viol=%s\n' "$viol"
    printf 'calls=%s\n' "$calls"
    printf 'allows=%s\n' "$allows"
    printf 'fixtures=%s\n' "$fixtures"
    printf 'skipped=%s\n' "$skipped"
    printf 'elapsed_s=%s\n' "$(elapsed)"
  } > "$base/state"
done

# global post snapshots + runtime guard flag
snap_git "$REPO" "$WORK" repo_global_after
snap_git "$KOTODAMA" "$WORK" kotodama_global_after
glob_refs=0
[ "$(cat "$WORK/snap.repo_global_before.head")" = "$(cat "$WORK/snap.repo_global_after.head")" ] && cmp -s "$WORK/snap.repo_global_before.refs" "$WORK/snap.repo_global_after.refs" && glob_refs=1
kot_refs=0
[ "$(cat "$WORK/snap.kotodama_global_before.head")" = "$(cat "$WORK/snap.kotodama_global_after.head")" ] && cmp -s "$WORK/snap.kotodama_global_before.refs" "$WORK/snap.kotodama_global_after.refs" && kot_refs=1

# ---- wave inventory (read-only) ----
python3 - "$WORK" "$REPO" <<'PY'
import json,os,sys
work,repo=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]
inv={"tests_results":[],"census_round2":[]}
for d,key in (("tests/results","tests_results"),("census/round-2","census_round2")):
    p=os.path.join(repo,d)
    if os.path.isdir(p):
        for f in sorted(os.listdir(p)):
            fp=os.path.join(p,f)
            if os.path.isfile(fp) and f not in ("final-57.json","final-58.json"):
                inv[key].append({"file":f,"bytes":os.path.getsize(fp)})
json.dump(inv,open(os.path.join(work,"out","inventory.json"),"w"),indent=1)
PY

# ---- aggregate ----
python3 - "$WORK" "$OUT" "$pushed_rel" "$glob_refs" "$kot_refs" "$DATE" "$START_TS" <<'PY'
import json,os,sys,time
work,out,pushed_rel,glob_refs,kot_refs,date,start_ts=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2],sys.argv[3],sys.argv[4]=="1",sys.argv[5]=="1",sys.argv[6],int(sys.argv[7])
def rd(p,default=""):
    try: return open(p,errors="replace").read().rstrip("\n")
    except OSError: return default
def first(p): return rd(p).split("\n")[0] if rd(p) else ""
def as_int(v):
    try: return int(v)
    except (TypeError,ValueError): return None
croot=os.path.join(work,"c")
names=sorted(os.listdir(croot)) if os.path.isdir(croot) else []
cands=[]
for name in names:
    b=os.path.join(croot,name)
    st={}
    for ln in rd(os.path.join(b,"state")).split("\n"):
        if not ln: continue
        k,_,v=ln.partition("="); st[k]=v
    o=os.path.join(b,"out")
    def line(sfx): return first(os.path.join(o,sfx+".out"))
    selftest_rc1=as_int(st.get("selftest_rc1")); selftest_rc2=as_int(st.get("selftest_rc2"))
    usage_rc=as_int(st.get("usage_rc")); noargs_rc=as_int(st.get("noargs_rc"))
    sec_line=line("sec"); kot_root_line=line("kot_root"); kot_scratch_line=line("kot_scratch"); pushed_line=line("pushed")
    fmt_ok=st.get("fmt_ok")=="1"
    static_matches=st.get("static_matches","-1")
    refs_unchanged=st.get("refs_unchanged")=="1"
    viol=as_int(st.get("viol")) or 0
    checks={}
    def chk(cid,pass_,critical,evidence):
        checks[cid]={"pass":pass_,"critical":critical,"evidence":evidence}
    chk("c01_tool_present",True,True,"%s sha256=%s size=%s mode=%s"%(name,st.get("sha"),st.get("size"),st.get("mode")))
